items.title: Bucky Pizzarelli interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, May 23, 2003 [interview 2 of 2]
items.q: My folks had a grocery store in Paterson, New Jersey, founded by Alexander Hamilton.

ctx.x: Yes. And we have some fireworks going on in the background, because everybody’s celebrating. I kind of wish we had been taping during our dinner just before this, because you were saying some great stuff. I was fascinated by your description of your family life and being a young person during the Depression.
Yes. My folks had a grocery store in Paterson, New Jersey, founded by Alexander Hamilton.
